name: Everybody Wants My Girl
storyline:
Ayano and Takumi are childhood friends, and spend all the time they're not busy pining for each other. It's a classic story of unrequited love... until it's not! In a twist of fate, they actually manage to confess their feelings to one another, and they couldn't be happier for it.

Unfortunately, there are countless hurdles in the way of their true love, especially when both Ayano and Takumi are high-profile individuals... They make a pact to keep it a secret from everyone—even friends and family. It's the safest way to approach the matter and avoid all sorts of problems down the line.

Alas, somebody seems to have found out anyway, and the rumors begin spreading... Who's behind it all? And how will these secret schemers threaten their perfect and pure happiness? Find out in this heart-throbbing tale of love and mystery!
summary: Ayano loves Takumi, and Takumi loves Ayano, a classic story of unrequited love... until it's not! They finally confess their love to each other, and they couldn't be happier for it. Unfortunately, relationships are not allowed. Can their love survive in secret?
